evals.prompt: Extract ads from this LinkedIn Ad Library URL: https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise. Get the first page of ads only.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file containing extracted ad data including advertiser names, ad types, headlines, descriptions, and detail URLs for ads visible on the first page.

evals.prompt: I want to analyze Wise's advertising on LinkedIn. Can you scrape their ad library and get info about all their ads? Limit to 2 pages of results.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with ad data from Wise showing their ad campaigns including targeting info, impressions, and destination URLs.

evals.prompt: Go to https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=wise&payer=wise and extract the following for each ad: advertiser name, ad headline, destination URL, and targeting parameters. Get 3 pages of results.
evals.expected_output: A JSON file with the specified fields extracted from ads across 3 pages of results.
